page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.6xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 8559C processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyper-threading, running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It is equipped with a 320 MB L3 cache and 192.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware highlight is the inclusion of 15,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong capabilities in memory and data processing. The server achieves top-tier Geekbench single-core and text processing scores, alongside strong Geekbench multi-core and image processing results. Memory performance is highlighted by a strong Passmark memory score and a strong large-block write bandwidth of 107.16 GB/sec. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks also perform strongly, with gzip compression reaching 34.65 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression reaching 14.39 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the i7ie.6xlarge offers a highly qualitative cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring massive local NVMe storage coupled with fast DDR5 memory. The lack of bundled public IPv4 addresses and GPU accelerators positions this instance strictly for CPU-bound, storage-heavy enterprise workloads. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, real-time analytics, and high-throughput web serving.
